Name: AT - Unusual Goats by CC
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Unusual Goats﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4f8F031.gif[/img]﻿[/b][/size][/center][center]This mod uses AT to change the goat t﻿extures. What are these weirdo goats up to? Hard to tell, honestly.[/center]
[size=5]How to Use:[/size]
- Download the AT zip file
- Unzip the file into your Mods folder
- Load up the game
- Get the AT Scissors from Robin and click on goats

[size=5]Known Issues:
[/size]- These textures are for adult goats only.

[size=5]Compatibilities:[/size]
- I think these pair nicely with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057?tab=description]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]﻿[/b]

[size=5]Future Plans:[/size]
- Possibly adding more colors, but more likely expanding into other animals and eventually combining them into one mod.
